Smooth quantile regression sensitivity check

Source: R/quant-rq.R
wgh_qgam_check.Rd

Fits qgam models with a varying-coefficient smooth of the exposure by age, y ~ s(age) + s(age, by = exposure) + extra, and reads exposure slopes by contrast. The by-smooth contains the linear exposure term, so a separate parametric exposure term is not added (it would not be identified, a problem met in the BMI and height-for-age distribution study (Ho 2026, medRxiv 2026.09.08.26362487)).

Usage

wgh_qgam_check(
  x,
  outcome = "haz",
  exposure = "baz",
  taus = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9),
  ages = c(6, 9, 12, 15),
  extra = NULL,
  k = 8
)

Arguments

x

Data.

outcome, exposure

Variable names.

taus

Quantiles.

ages

Ages for the slopes.

extra

Additional parametric terms (character), for example "site".

k

Basis dimension.

Value

A tibble of slopes by age and quantile.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("qgam", quietly = TRUE)) {
  d <- growdat[growdat$sex == "Female" & growdat$age >= 5, ]
  wgh_qgam_check(d, taus = 0.5, ages = c(6, 12), k = 5)
}
#> Estimating learning rate. Each dot corresponds to a loss evaluation. 
#> qu = 0.5........done 
#> # A tibble: 2 × 3
#>     age   tau estimate
#>   <dbl> <dbl>    <dbl>
#> 1     6   0.5    0.102
#> 2    12   0.5    0.107
# }
